monitoring_incident.observed: Original persistent client did not receive terminal output; two local marker waits expired after 90 and 70 minutes. A recovery connection replayed completion showing 18m41s compilation and four passing tests.
monitoring_incident.conclusion: Elapsed wait did not measure compilation duration. The transport failure cause remains unknown.
monitoring_incident.recovery: No build was cancelled. Recovery attempted SIGTSTP then background resumption; replay showed the command already finished successfully and jobs inventory was empty, so no job was resumed. A fresh persistent recovery client used a new empty queue, retained all evidence and cache, and exited normally.
monitoring_incident.future_requirement: Long commands need terminal receipts plus an observable heartbeat and SSH liveness limits; an idle marker alone cannot establish ongoing compilation.
